frozen_rule: For a deployment-style primary comparison, model training and hyperparameter selection must not use observations chronologically later than the final test period, unless the study explicitly adopts a non-temporal transfer-learning protocol and discloses it.

A_earlier_same_family.description: Training chronologically precedes test, same workload family.

B_independent_same_time_shard.description: Different cluster/region/shard, same or overlapping time window, no overlapping objects/events, no future temporal advantage.

C_different_family.caveat: May be less representative; must be predeclared, not chosen after seeing results.

D_later_same_family.description: Chronologically after test, same workload family.
D_later_same_family.eligible_as: non-temporal transfer-learning study only, if explicitly disclosed as such -- never presented as a deployment-style evaluation

E_same_trace_prefix.description: Earlier prefix of the SAME trace instance being tested, with all labels censored strictly before the score boundary.

F_unverifiable_or_interleaved_order.description: Raw source order does not correspond to chronological order (grouped by entity, alphabetical, or otherwise non-temporal), and/or the candidate segment's calendar range is not disjoint from the test segment's calendar range.
F_unverifiable_or_interleaved_order.note: Not covered by classifications A-E; requires either re-sorting the source by verified timestamp before splitting, or a different data source, before any eligibility claim can be made.

G_no_temporal_axis.description: Source has no verifiable time field at all (static catalog or logging format without timestamps).
G_no_temporal_axis.eligible_as: content-disjoint partition only (closer to classification C/B in spirit), with an explicit disclosure that no temporal claim is being made

conclusion: 0 of 7 families are classified A, B, C, or E (the classifications eligible for a deployment-style primary comparison) under the fair_v1 extraction strategy. fair_v1 is therefore not eligible as constructed. See docs/reviewer_fairness_temporal_rules.md for the protocol decision.
